roadmap.title: Map Chamber runs for all four houses
roadmap.description: Start a fresh game for each house, keep a backup of the autosave made at the Sorting Ceremony, and play to the Map Chamber in Jackdaw's Rest. Do the full game with one of them.

roadmap.title: Main story
roadmap.description: Play the main quests through The Final Repository, learning the early spells, Ancient Magic, the Loom and gear upgrades along the way.

roadmap.title: Side quests, systems and combat tasks
roadmap.description: Finish the relationship lines, Deek's quests, flying and the Room of Requirement tasks while using Ancient Magic on each new enemy type.

roadmap.title: Collectibles and endgame
roadmap.description: Free-roam the world for Floo Flames, Merlin Trials, statues and collections, reach level 34 and 40, then win the House Cup.

achievements.summary: Win the House Cup.

guide.context: Main-story play leaves you near level 25, so you need side content to reach level 34.

steps.text: Finish the main quest called Weasley's Watchful Eye.
Reach character level 34. Do side quests and collect items until you get there.
Go to @loc{The Great Hall} in Hogwarts Castle and watch the House Cup ceremony to finish the main quest called The House Cup.

achievements.summary: Finish all seven of Natsai Onai's relationship quests.

guide.context: The quests unlock as the story moves on and can be done after it. No choice can lock you out.

steps.text: Do @npc{Natsai Onai}'s quests as they appear: first The Lost Child, next A Basis for Blackmail, then Mum's the Word. Four more follow: Grief and Vengeance (fourth), Finding Focus (fifth), Harlow's Last Stand (sixth), and Acting On Instinct (last).

achievements.summary: Save a dragon.

steps.text: Finish the main quest called Fire and Vice.

achievements.summary: Finish all seven of Poppy Sweeting's relationship quests.

guide.context: The quests unlock as the story moves on and can be done after it. No choice can lock you out.

steps.text: Do @npc{Poppy Sweeting}'s quests as they appear: first A Dragon Debrief, next Poached Egg, then Surprise Meeting. After those come The Centaur and the Stone (fourth), It's in the Stars (fifth), A Bird in the Hand (sixth), and Poppy Blooms (last).

achievements.summary: Finish all nine of Sebastian Sallow's relationship quests.

guide.context: The Unforgivable Curses taught in this line are not needed for any achievement.

steps.text: Do @npc{Sebastian Sallow}'s quests as they appear. All nine are named In the Shadow of: the Bloodline, the Study, Discovery, Time, Distance, Hope, the Relic, Fate, and Friendship.

achievements.description: Beat Imelda's time on all broom races.
achievements.summary: Beat Imelda's time on every broom race.

steps.text: Finish the main quest called Flying Class, then the side quest called Flight Test.
Buy the best broom you can afford.
Beat @npc{Imelda}'s time on all three courses: Irondale, the South Coast course, and the Hogwarts Quidditch pitch.

achievements.summary: Complete all side quests.

guide.context: There are 57 side quests in total.

steps.text: Open the quest list and finish every side quest.
Talk to the Magical Well southeast of @loc{Aranshire} to start the side quest called Well, Well, Well.
Finish the side quest called Follow the Butterflies before opening other butterfly chests, and do not unlock any @loc{North Ford Bog} cage before starting Take the Biscuit.

achievements.description: Complete all tiers of a challenge
achievements.summary: Complete every tier of one challenge.

guide.context: Challenges also fill the Collector's Edition collections, so this comes along with that work.

steps.text: Open the Challenges tab in the menu and finish all tiers of any one challenge.

achievements.summary: Complete every collection in the progress menu.

guide.context: The Collections menu holds 603 items, and each group below matches one of its sections. Traits, Wand Handles, and Conjurations that come from chests are random: each of the 168 collection chests always holds the same kind of item, but which one you get changes. Bandit camp chests hold Traits. A bandit-camp chest can fail to give a Trait, so reload your last autosave if one does. Do not leave the side quest called Follow the Butterflies half done before opening another butterfly chest, because that can lock you out of one Conjuration. Claim every challenge reward by selecting the finished tier in the Challenges menu.

collectibles.name: 1. Hogsmeade
collectibles.method: Cast Revelio at the entrance.

collectibles.name: 2. Enchanted Staircase
collectibles.method: Check the left corner just inside the door.

collectibles.name: 3. Ceridwen's Precarious Cauldrons
collectibles.method: Stand in front of the shop, across from Tomes and Scrolls.

collectibles.name: 4. Mounted Hog's Head
collectibles.method: Look behind the barkeeper.

collectibles.name: 5. Hog's Head Docks
collectibles.method: Walk to the docks at the back of the pub.

collectibles.name: 6. The Magic Neep Cart
collectibles.method: Stand to the left of the merchant Timothy Teasdale.

collectibles.name: 7. J. Pippin's Potions
collectibles.method: Look behind the shopkeeper.

collectibles.name: 8. Hogsmeade Community Garden
collectibles.location: Garden across from J. Pippin's Potions
collectibles.method: Go through the small wooden gate. The page is beside the cabbages.

collectibles.name: 9. Ollivanders Wand Shop
collectibles.method: Stand in front of the shop.

collectibles.name: 10. Spintwitches Sporting Needs
collectibles.method: Cast Revelio inside the shop.

collectibles.name: 11. The Three Broomsticks
collectibles.location: Ground floor of The Three Broomsticks
collectibles.method: Walk to the end of the room.

collectibles.name: 12. Three Broomsticks Private Room
collectibles.location: Top floor of The Three Broomsticks
collectibles.method: Unlock the level 1 door, which needs Alohomora from the main quest called The Caretaker's Lunar Lament.

collectibles.name: 13. Butterbeer Barrels
collectibles.location: Outside The Three Broomsticks, north-east wall
collectibles.method: Stand in front of the two big barrels.

collectibles.name: 14. Zonko's Joke Shop
collectibles.method: Turn left from the last page.

collectibles.name: 15. Frog Spawn Soap
collectibles.method: Check the left corner of the shop.

collectibles.name: 16. Dungbomb
collectibles.method: Go up to the top floor.

collectibles.name: 17. Water Well
collectibles.method: Walk east along the road, then turn left to the well.

collectibles.name: 18. Gladrags Wizardwear
collectibles.method: Stand in front of the shop.

collectibles.name: 19. Gladrags Mannequin
collectibles.method: Stand in front of the shopkeeper.

collectibles.name: 20. Sneakoscope
collectibles.method: Look in the corner by a bird skeleton.

collectibles.name: 21. Scrivenshaft Cats
collectibles.method: Enter the house with the blue and white sign.

collectibles.name: 22. Brood and Peck
collectibles.method: Check the corner to the right of the shopkeeper.

collectibles.name: 23. Hengist of Woodcroft
collectibles.method: Stand before the twisted tree beside the flame.

collectibles.name: 24. Magical Mail
collectibles.method: Go in. The building has owls above its entrance.

collectibles.name: 25. Tea Shop Decor
collectibles.method: Check the left corner just inside.

collectibles.name: 26. Honeydukes
collectibles.method: Stand in front of the shop.

collectibles.name: 27. Fizzing Whizzbees
collectibles.method: Turn left on entering and look at the Fizzing Whizzbees poster.

collectibles.name: 28. Exploding Bonbons
collectibles.method: Turn left on entering and check the corner by a pot of gold coins.

collectibles.name: 29. The Dogweed and Deathcap Tree
collectibles.method: Stand in front of the shopkeeper.

collectibles.name: 30. Abandoned Shop
collectibles.location: The Old Fool, a lone house on a hill north-west of town
collectibles.method: Stand in front of the house.

collectibles.name: 31. Spider Sign
collectibles.location: Beware Spiders sign by a bridge
collectibles.method: Walk up to the sign. If you cannot use the page, beat the nearby enemies first.

collectibles.name: 32. Antique Horn
collectibles.method: Walk to the end of the jetty.

collectibles.name: 33. Pumpkin Fizz
collectibles.location: House at the north edge of Upper Hogsfield
collectibles.method: Go in. Its map icon helps you track it.

collectibles.name: 34. Squib Cottage
collectibles.location: Small house with a pumpkin garden
collectibles.method: Stand outside the house.

collectibles.name: 35. Runespoor Egg
collectibles.method: Fly into the camp on a broom and check the ruined building in its north-west corner.

collectibles.name: 36. Chocolate Frogs
collectibles.method: Follow the map icon to the terrace.

collectibles.name: 37. Alihotsy Fudge
collectibles.location: Bench on a hill facing Hogwarts
collectibles.method: Sit near the bench and cast Revelio.

collectibles.name: 38. Hogsmeade Station Ticket Office
collectibles.method: Stand at the office entrance door.

collectibles.name: 39. Spider Parts
collectibles.method: Stand before the merchant beside the open cage.

collectibles.name: 40. Groundkeeper's Tools
collectibles.method: Check the hut.

collectibles.name: 41. Heridean Black Scale
collectibles.location: Small camp in the woods, south of Lower Hogsfield
collectibles.method: Stand in front of the tent, along the road heading south.

collectibles.name: 42. Murtlap Tentacles
collectibles.location: River with cairns, east of the last camp
collectibles.method: Walk straight east of page 41 to the river.

collectibles.name: 43. Doxy Egg
collectibles.method: Check the east-side tent beside the wooden cages.

collectibles.name: 44. Lace Doily
collectibles.method: Look under the tree.

collectibles.name: 45. Ginger Root
collectibles.method: Turn left on arriving.

collectibles.name: 46. The Tilted House
collectibles.method: Find the house wrapped in roots with a tree growing from its roof.

collectibles.name: 47. Beehives
collectibles.method: Stand in front of the beehives.

collectibles.name: 48. Enchanted Scarecrow
collectibles.method: Check the small garden between two houses.

collectibles.name: 49. Peruvian Instant Darkness Powder
collectibles.location: Ruins east of the West Hogwarts Valley flame
collectibles.method: Mark it on the map and search the ruins.

collectibles.name: 50. Broken Binoculars
collectibles.method: Fly up on a broom.

collectibles.name: 51. The Feldcroft Well
collectibles.method: Stand by the well. Its icon shows on the minimap.

collectibles.name: 52. Practice Dummy
collectibles.method: Stand before the training dummies.

collectibles.name: 53. Lovage Bouquet
collectibles.method: Look for the page at a rocky wall.

collectibles.name: 54. Cinnamon Bark
collectibles.method: Go downstairs to the furnace.

collectibles.name: 55. Jewelled Brooch
collectibles.method: Stand at the windmill.

collectibles.name: 56. Abandoned Bothy
collectibles.location: House near the middle of the bog
collectibles.method: Stand in front of the house.

collectibles.name: 57. Antique Compass
collectibles.method: Cast Revelio as soon as you arrive. The page is right ahead.
collectibles.note: To reach the coast on foot, cross the medium-sized bandit camp at the bog's south-east, then the large mine and the Coastal Cavern.

collectibles.name: 58. Acromantula Venom
collectibles.method: Look outside, next to the big tent.

collectibles.name: 59. Pungous Onion Bulb
collectibles.method: Look on a broken roof beside the road.

collectibles.name: 60. Dragon Skeleton
collectibles.method: Stand before the whale skeleton on the beach.

collectibles.name: 61. Giant Shade Tree
collectibles.method: Stand under the tree.

collectibles.name: 62. Astronomy Telescope
collectibles.method: Turn right and climb all the way up to the balcony telescope.

collectibles.name: 63. Tapestry of Barnabas the Barmy
collectibles.method: Go forward, descend the left stairs, and enter the left corridor. The first wall on that side shows 4 green trolls.

collectibles.name: 64. Dark Tower Cell
collectibles.method: Go ahead and through the first right-hand door, left up the stairs, unlock the level 1 door, climb the spiral stairs, and unlock the level 2 door on the rooftop.

collectibles.name: 65. Augurey Skeleton
collectibles.location: Defence Against the Dark Arts Tower flame
collectibles.method: Go down the first stairs, turn right, and go down another set. The page is ahead by a bird skeleton display case.

collectibles.name: 66. Hebridean Black Skeleton
collectibles.location: Defence Against the Dark Arts Classroom flame
collectibles.method: Go straight into the classroom and up the stairs at its end.

collectibles.name: 67. Serpentine Beast Window
collectibles.location: Defence Against the Dark Arts Classroom flame
collectibles.method: Turn right and descend the stairs, then follow the right-hand wall to a blue mosaic window.

collectibles.name: 68. Boggart Closet
collectibles.method: Turn round, enter the south-west door, and take the first door right of the stairs.

collectibles.name: 69. Painting of Illyius
collectibles.method: Turn round, enter the south-west door, and turn right to the painting of three people.

collectibles.name: 70. Wyvern Fountain
collectibles.method: Turn left to the well with the dragon statue.

collectibles.name: 71. Partial Transfiguration
collectibles.method: Enter Professor Weasley's classroom ahead. The page is on the left.

collectibles.name: 72. Pungent Passage
collectibles.method: Turn left and go down the stairs into the green smog.
collectibles.note: It counts toward the Astronomy Wing.

collectibles.name: 73. Alchemy Class
collectibles.method: Take the left-hand door, descend the stairs straight away, and pass through one more door into the Dungeons. Go down to the big sleeping dragon statue, take the hallway straight across from it, and unlock the level 2 door at its end. The page is just inside.
collectibles.note: It counts toward the Astronomy Wing.

collectibles.name: 74. Broken Broom
collectibles.method: Walk a few steps ahead and slightly right, by a shelf with a broom.

collectibles.name: 75. Flattened Armour
collectibles.method: Walk a few steps ahead and slightly left, by a suit of armour.

collectibles.name: 76. Three Sisters Bells
collectibles.method: Turn right to the three bells.

collectibles.name: 77. Wooden Cat
collectibles.method: Turn right and climb the stairs. The page is before the right-hand door, by a glass case holding a cat.

collectibles.name: 78. Goblin Artefact
collectibles.method: Turn left and climb the stairs. It is on the right, by a case with two crossed polearms.

collectibles.name: 79. Scorch Marks
collectibles.method: Turn left, climb the first stairs, then the next set on the left. It is at the top, by scorch marks shaped like a person.

collectibles.name: 80. Frog Chair
collectibles.method: Keep climbing the same staircase to the music room, right of an eye-chest. Check the lectern with frogs on it.

collectibles.name: 81. History of Magic Windows
collectibles.location: Classroom up from the Bell Tower Courtyard
collectibles.method: Climb the first stairs on the left, go straight through the door, climb another flight, and go straight through the next door to enter a classroom. The page is at the mosaic window on the right that is inscribed Merlin.

collectibles.name: 82. Sphinx Statue
collectibles.method: Turn left through the locked door, then right to the Sphinx statue.

collectibles.name: 83. Werewolf Saga Tapestries
collectibles.method: From the Bell Tower Courtyard flame, take the left-hand door, descend the stairs at once, and pass through one more door. Walk through the red K on the tapestry, which is a door, then onward to the end of the path.

collectibles.name: 84. Urn of Ashes
collectibles.method: With the yellow-dressed woman and girl tapestry before you, turn left to the dragon vase above the stairs down.

collectibles.name: 85. Sleeping Dragon Statue
collectibles.method: Go downstairs. The page waits on the left, before the huge sleeping dragon.

collectibles.name: 86. Important Muggle Artefact
collectibles.method: Take the path opposite the dragon statue and go through the first left-hand door. The page sits on the left, before a cannon.

collectibles.name: 87. Castle Ramparts
collectibles.method: Look north-east for a tower with a dark pipe running down one side. Enter and find the page at its centre.

collectibles.name: 88. Glumbumbles
collectibles.method: Go through the arches in the north-east corner, follow the path to a second arch, and turn left to the beehives.

collectibles.name: 89. Bloody Meat
collectibles.method: Go north-west to the exit gate, turn left before the Hogwarts North Exit flame, enter the big gate, and unlock the level 1 door on the right.

collectibles.name: 90. Caged Bathtub
collectibles.location: Wall tower south-west of the Flying Class Lawn
collectibles.method: Follow the castle wall south-west to the second-to-last tower and look in front of a cage. You can fly up.
collectibles.note: It is outside the castle but counts here.

collectibles.name: 91. Quidditch Pitch
collectibles.method: Fly south behind the green Quidditch tower to the mossy cliff before the castle wall.
collectibles.note: It is outside the castle but counts here.

collectibles.name: 92. Hogwarts Owls
collectibles.location: Tower on the mountain, south of the Quidditch field
collectibles.method: Go in the front door and up the stairs to the floor before the ladder. Face a window.
collectibles.note: It is outside the castle but counts here.

collectibles.name: 93. The Old Librarian
collectibles.method: Turn left and climb the spiral stairs to the large painting of a red-robed mage.
collectibles.note: You find it in the Library Annex, yet it counts toward the Bell Tower Wing.

collectibles.name: 94. Grimbald Weft
collectibles.location: Side quest History of Magic Class
collectibles.method: It is collected automatically during the quest.

collectibles.name: 95. Waving Knight
collectibles.location: Side quest History of Magic Class
collectibles.method: It is collected automatically during the quest.

collectibles.name: 96. The Hogwarts Architect
collectibles.method: Go up the first stairs ahead. It is at the top, before a lion statue.

collectibles.name: 97. House-Elf Recipe Book
collectibles.method: Turn right and go a little way down the spiral stairs, by wooden shelves.

collectibles.name: 98. Hufflepuff Barrels
collectibles.method: Continue to the bottom, go straight, and turn right to a keg.

collectibles.name: 99. Salazar Slytherin's Scriptorium
collectibles.method: Once Sebastian's relationship quest (the one named In the Shadow of the Study) has opened the Scriptorium, descend the stairs ahead, bear right, and walk in. The page is downstairs in the middle.
collectibles.note: This room only opens after Sebastian's quest named In the Shadow of the Study, and you may have taken the page there already.

collectibles.name: 100. Kelpie Statue
collectibles.method: Go straight down, then left up the stairs to the statue of a man on a sea monster.

collectibles.name: 101. Honeydukes Passageway
collectibles.method: Turn round to a witch statue.
collectibles.note: It counts toward the Grand Staircase.

collectibles.name: 102. Ravenclaw Bust
collectibles.method: Go ahead and upstairs. The page is mid-staircase, before a white marble bust.

collectibles.name: 103. Ravenclaw Doorknocker
collectibles.method: Climb to the door with a big golden raven.

collectibles.name: 104. Moving Staircase
collectibles.method: Turn right and go down two staircases to the balcony.

collectibles.name: 105. Troll Armour
collectibles.method: Cast Revelio on arrival. The page is in front of the big troll armour.

collectibles.name: 106. Centaur Armour
collectibles.method: Go right of the troll armour to a centaur in a display case.

collectibles.name: 107. House-Elf Armor
collectibles.method: Move right of the centaur armour to a small house-elf armour.

collectibles.name: 108. Goblet of Fire Casket
collectibles.method: Turn round and enter the room. Find it at the first pillar to your right.

collectibles.name: 109. Trophy Room
collectibles.method: Turn round and enter the room. It is at the second pillar, slightly left of centre.

collectibles.name: 110. Headmaster's Office Gargoyle
collectibles.method: Go right, through the gate, up the stairs and spiral staircase, and turn left through the top door.
collectibles.note: The path opens in the main quest called Niamh Fitzgerald's Trial.

collectibles.name: 111. Sleeping Portraits
collectibles.method: Go up the stairs. It is right after them.

collectibles.name: 112. The Sorting Hat
collectibles.method: It is on the right in the same room.

collectibles.name: 113. Quill of Acceptance and the Book of Admittance
collectibles.method: Unlock the level 2 door on the left, then the level 3 balcony door, and climb to the top room. Take the Key of Admittance from the table by the fireplace. Use it on the puzzle door opposite the staircase near page 108, and climb to the page by a book.
collectibles.note: Using the key also counts as one Hogwarts Secret.

collectibles.name: 114. The Great Hall Ceiling
collectibles.method: Step forward and slightly left, between the Gryffindor and Ravenclaw benches.

collectibles.name: 115. Owl Lectern
collectibles.method: Walk to the far end, to the lectern.

collectibles.name: 116. The Yawning Gargoyle
collectibles.method: Leave by the first gate on the right and walk to the statue ahead.

collectibles.name: 117. House Point Hourglass
collectibles.method: Turn round, pass two gates, and turn right to four hourglasses.

collectibles.name: 118. Hogwarts Crest
collectibles.method: Pass the gate left of the hourglasses and go down the stairs to the golden crest of all four houses.

collectibles.name: 119. Slytherin's Sink
collectibles.method: Descend straight ahead, follow the right-hand path to its end beside a suit of armour, and go through the first right-hand door, the Slytherin bathroom. Check the sink.
collectibles.note: It counts toward the Great Hall. Do not use the door on the left.

collectibles.name: 120. Detention Chamber
collectibles.method: Leave, turn left, climb two short flights, take the second corridor on the left to its end, and unlock the level 2 door.

collectibles.name: 121. Deathday Party Room
collectibles.method: Leave and take the second cell along on your right (it has a level 1 lock), then carry on to the Deathday Party Room. After turning left, the first page sits by the tables.

collectibles.name: 122. Headless Hunt Tapestry
collectibles.method: The second page here is in front of the tapestry on the west side.

collectibles.name: 123. Pear Portrait
collectibles.method: Turn right and go all the way down the spiral stairs. It is on the left, in a painting before a key.
collectibles.note: It counts toward the Great Hall.

collectibles.name: 124. Kitchen Tables
collectibles.method: Go through the Pear Portrait (tickle the pear). The page stands at the kitchen's centre.

collectibles.name: 125. House-Elf Living Quarters
collectibles.method: Check the back corner of the same room.

collectibles.name: 126. Black Lake
collectibles.method: Check the boathouse's outer north-east corner, at the water beside a little boat.

collectibles.name: 127. Underground Harbour
collectibles.method: Walk a few steps ahead and take the first right door at the wall with a horse print. The lift takes you down. The page is by the last boat on the right.
collectibles.note: Professor Weasley's assignment makes you take this page.

collectibles.name: 128. Central Hall Fountain
collectibles.method: Walk ahead to the fountain with a horse. The page is behind it.

collectibles.name: 129. Palmistry Model
collectibles.method: Go ahead up the stairs, climb the ladder, and stand in the middle of the classroom.

collectibles.name: 130. Arithmancy Classroom
collectibles.method: Turn round into the wooden attic and take the first right to a puzzle door. Spin the left symbol (owl) 3 times and the right symbol (three-headed hydra) 2 times, then reveal. The page is just behind the next door.

collectibles.name: 131. Portrait of Sir Cadogan
collectibles.method: Turn round, go all the way down, then up the straight stairs before the spiral. Turn right at the top to the portrait.

collectibles.name: 132. Greenhouse Tree
collectibles.method: The page is hidden behind the tree ahead.

collectibles.name: 133. Dirigible Plums
collectibles.method: Enter the greenhouse ahead and go downstairs to the tree with yellow fruit.

collectibles.name: 134. Enchanted Books
collectibles.method: Turn round, walk to the hallway's end, turn right between the bookshelves, and pass the Restricted Section gate. Go down the stairs, follow the only path, then down again. The page is slightly left, by a small bookshelf.

collectibles.name: 135. Statue of Gregory the Swarmy
collectibles.method: Turn round west, take a couple of steps, and turn right to a mage statue holding potion pots.

collectibles.name: 136. Professor Sharp's Auror Badge
collectibles.method: Walk through the door ahead and again into the classroom. It is at the end, right of the teacher's desk.

collectibles.name: 137. Gorgon Portrait
collectibles.method: Turn round, pass the gate left of the flame, go downstairs, and turn right to a puzzle door. Spin the left symbol (Graphorn head) 2 times and the right (unicorn head) once. The page is behind it, in front of a portrait.
collectibles.note: It counts toward the Library Annex.

collectibles.name: 138. Book on Intermediate Transfiguration
collectibles.method: Speak with Sophronia in the upstairs Library and answer her quiz. You collect the page afterwards whatever you answer.
collectibles.note: This cannot be missed.

collectibles.name: 139. The Well of Four Beasts
collectibles.method: Turn round, cross the wooden bridge into the courtyard, and stand before the well with four winged-beast statues.

collectibles.name: 140. Unicorn Fountain
collectibles.method: Cast Revelio where you arrive. It is before a green unicorn statue.

collectibles.name: 141. Clock Mechanics
collectibles.method: From the Hospital Wing flame, enter the Clock Tower to the right. Descend the first right-hand stairs, then again, then turn sharply left and descend, and finish by climbing the stairs at the end, to the south corner one floor under the top.

collectibles.name: 142. Prefect's Bathroom
collectibles.method: Turn round, descend the stairs, and take the first left-hand door. Find the page on the left, beside a wall mermaid.

collectibles.name: 143. Boris the Bewildered
collectibles.method: Turn round and go down the stairs to the bronze sorcerer statue.

collectibles.name: 144. Jewel-Encrusted Tortoise Shell
collectibles.method: Go down the spiral staircase behind the statue, then the next stairs. It waits in a corner before a level 3 door.

collectibles.name: 145. Adventure Novel Set
collectibles.method: Go down one more floor to a puzzle door, turn right, and enter the first right-hand door, which has a level 2 lock. Check the right side of the bedroom.

collectibles.name: 146. Portrait of a Buffalo
collectibles.method: Walk to the end of the floor. It is in the south-west corner before a buffalo portrait.
collectibles.note: You may already have it from the welcome tour, depending on your house.

collectibles.name: 147. Fat Lady Portrait
collectibles.method: Walk to the far end of the floor and climb the left-hand spiral stairs. Turn left at the top to find a portrait of a woman in pink.

collectibles.name: 148. Map of Argyllshire
collectibles.method: Walk to the far end of the floor and descend the left-hand spiral stairs. Keep straight between two suits of armour to the wall ahead.

collectibles.name: 149. Lachlan the Lanky
collectibles.method: Turn right, go down the stairs, then turn right a second time straight away; the statue stands behind the stairs.

collectibles.name: 150. Haunted Toilets
collectibles.method: Turn round and take the corridor on the left. Look behind the final door on that side.

collectibles.name: Stoneback Dugbog
collectibles.location: Swamps and dugbog nests, such as South Sea Bog and North Ford Bog
collectibles.method: Meet it in combat. Being near it is enough.

collectibles.name: Great Spined Dugbog
collectibles.location: Swamps and dugbog nests, such as South Sea Bog and North Ford Bog
collectibles.method: Meet it in combat. Being near it is enough.

collectibles.name: Cottongrass Dugbog
collectibles.location: Swamps and dugbog nests, such as South Sea Bog and North Ford Bog
collectibles.method: Meet it in combat. Being near it is enough.

collectibles.name: Ashwinder Duellist
collectibles.method: Meet it in combat. Being near it is enough.

achievements.summary: Defeat 50 enemies with Petrificus Totalus.

steps.text: Learn Disillusionment and Petrificus Totalus by finishing the main quest named Secrets of the Restricted Section.
Cast Disillusionment, sneak up behind an enemy, and cast Petrificus Totalus when the prompt shows. Do this 50 times.

achievements.summary: Reach a combo of 100 hits.

guide.context: Getting hit resets the combo.

steps.text: Fight many enemies at once and keep hitting them without taking damage until the counter reaches 100.
Near Upper Hogsfield, a treasure vault holds Inferi that stay alive until hit with fire, so the combo can run on.
